day.reading: (2/s) ln(2Ne) is the fixation time of a beneficial allele and enters the six/seven figure
day.holds: arithmetic exact: 19,807 (printed 19,800); a standard deterministic sweep-time approximation

critic.reading: deterministic sweep time, not the conditional mean; a latency, not a spacing (F1)
critic.holds: conditional mean 8,532 (diffusion 8,480), so the formula overstates it 2.32x at s = 0.001

notes: The formula is the exact deterministic time from 1/(2Ne) to 1 - 1/(2Ne) under dp/dt = s p(1 - p) (19,806.6 against 19,807.0). The Zenodo text's window 0.01 -> 0.99 does not match it: the same dynamics give (2/s) ln 99 = 9,190, and ln 9,801 = 9.190 under the same prefactor gives 18,380; neither log is ln(2Ne) = 9.9035, so the stated window and the computed 19,807 use different starting points. Attribution: the claim files find the formula not in Kimura & Ohta 1969 (Z19984826 cites Charlesworth 1994); neither paper is in sources/raw/, so the record holds the claim files' statements, not the papers. The latency question (does it bound the count) is M-115/M-602, not this record.
